info.name: Kubernetes List events in a namespace

params.name: namespace
params.description: The namespace name to scope the request to.

params.name: fieldSelector
params.description: Selector expression to filter resources by field values. Supports equality (=, ==, !=) on specific fields. Example: status.phase=Running,spec.nodeName=node1

params.name: labelSelector
params.description: Selector expression to filter resources by label. Supports equality (=, ==, !=), set-based (in, notin, exists) operations. Example: app=nginx,tier=frontend

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of resources to return in a single response. Use with the continue parameter to paginate through large result sets.

params.name: watch
params.description: Watch for changes to the described resources and return them as a stream of add, update, and remove notifications. Specify resourceVersion to watch from a specific version.

items.docs: Returns a list of events in the specified namespace. Events are records of occurrences that happened in the cluster, such as pod scheduling decisions, container restarts, resource quota violations, and node conditions changes.
